Localize naive datetime to Spanish timezone spanish_dt = spanish_tz.localize(siar_datetime) # 2. Convert to UTC utc_dt = spanish_dt.astimezone(utc_tz) # 3. Convert to UTC string for database storage measurement_time_utc = fields.Datetime.to_string(utc_dt) value = float(reading[magnitude]) try: remotecontrol.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', {'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'measurement_time': measurement_time_utc}, {'remotecontrol_origin_id': remotecontrol.id, 'value': value}) upserts = upserts + 1 readings_summary.append({ 'measurement_time': measurement_time_utc, 'value': value}) except Exception as e: errs = errs + 1 readings_summary.append({ 'measurement_time': reading['Fecha'], 'value': reading[magnitude], 'error': str(e)}) total_upserts = total_upserts + upserts total_errors = total_errors + errs items.append({'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'station': station, 'magnitude': magnitude, 'url': url_request, 'status': 200, 'points_found': len(data_list), 'upserts': total_upserts, 'errors': total_errors, 'readings': readings_summary}) else: items.append({'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'station': station, 'magnitude': magnitude, 'status': code, 'error': mensaje_respuesta, 'url': url_request}) except Exception as e: items.append({'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'station': station, 'magnitude': magnitude, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e), 'url': url_request}) local_dt = fields.Datetime.to_string(fields.Datetime.context_timestamp( self, fields.Datetime.from_string(fields.Datetime.now()))) audit = {'executed_at': local_dt, 'final_date': final_date, 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items} try: # Added ensure_ascii to avoid issues with special chars in JSON audit_json = json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2, default=str) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8')) except Exception as json_error: # Fallback: create a simplified audit if there are issues simple_audit = {'executed_at': local_dt, 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'error': str(json_error)} audit_json = json.dumps(simple_audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8')) fname = 'readings_fetch_%s.json' % local_dt.replace('-','').replace(' ','_').replace(':','') att = env['ir.attachment'].create({'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': remotecontrol.id}) remotecontrol.message_post(body=u"[Readings] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id]) bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id

SiAR · Odoo Integration Help

Official API docs: https://servicio.mapa.gob.es/websiar/ControlesDatosAPI/Manual Web API SiAR Versión 1.0.pdf

1) Reading Acquisition Procedure (default)


The procedure to be executed to obtain readings is SiAR: Daily Sync, and it consists of the following actions:


  1. Action SiAR: Get devices (plan) → instantiates bag['sensors_plan'] based on the configuration of devices and sensors. If the variable selected_device_id is instantiated, only that device will be taken into account.

  2. Action SiAR: Get readings → performs the call to the Web API SiAR, using the data from bag['sensors_plan'], and after obtaining the readings, persists them in the table mdm_measurement_device_sensor_reading.

2) Remotecontrol Configuration


Communication with the remotecontrol is carried out through a REST API, whose base URL is https://servicio.mapama.gob.es/apisiar/API/v1/Datos


It is important that each remote control installation has its own API key. This API key can be obtained as follows:


  1. Go to https://servicio.mapa.gob.es/websiar, click on API SIAR, and select Register new user in CAS (follow the instructions).

  2. Once you have a username and password, repeat the previous step, but this time select Registered user in CAS.

  3. In the SIAR API Data form, note down the content of the API KEY text box.

  4. Once you have the API key, go to the remotecontrol form (Settings / Remote Control / Remotes menu) and edit the Connection Parameters field (connection_params), entering the API key in the api_key entry.

3) Device configuration


In the device form (Measurement Devices / Sensory / Devices menu), in addition to assigning the SiAR Web API remotecontrol, it is also necessary to edit the Remotecontrol Parameters field (remotecontrol_params), specifying the code of the agroclimatic station from which readings will be collected and, optionally, a start date for the first reading (if not specified, the first day of the current month will be assumed).

  "start_date": [start_date]

4) Sensor configuration


A sensor must be created for each of the magnitudes to be read. In SiAR, the list of possible magnitudes is as follows:


  • TempMedia: Average temperature
  • TempMax: Maximum temperature
  • HorMinTempMax: Time of maximum temperature
  • TempMin: Minimum temperature
  • HorMinTempMin: Time of minimum temperature
  • HumedadMedia: Average humidity
  • HumedadMax: Maximum humidity
  • HorMinHumMax: Time of maximum humidity
  • HumedadMin: Minimum humidity
  • HorMinHumMin: Time of minimum humidity
  • VelViento: Wind speed
  • DirViento: Wind direction
  • VelVientoMax: Maximum wind speed
  • HorMinVelMax: Time of maximum wind speed
  • DirVientoVelMax: Wind direction at time of maximum speed
  • Radiacion: Solar radiation
  • Precipitación: Precipitation
  • TempSuelo1: Soil temperature at 10 cm
  • TempSuelo2: Soil temperature at 20 cm
  • EtPmon: Reference evapotranspiration
  • PePmon: Effective precipitation

Sensors can be accessed from the device form by clicking the Sensors button. Once there, you can create a sensor by assigning it a name, a type, and a unit of measure. You must also edit the Remotecontrol Parameters field (remotecontrol_params), entering the remotecontrol parameter to be measured (one of the magnitudes listed above).


{
  "magnitude": [magnitude]
}

5) Examples of reading acquisition


Starting point:


  • We have configured the Web API SiAR remotecontrol.
  • We have registered and configured a device for this remotecontrol.
  • We have created and configured two sensors for the device: Et0 and Pe (reference evapotranspiration and effective precipitation).

Case No. 1: Global reading, taking into account the newly created device and other possible devices:


  1. Menu Settings / Remote Control / Remotes and select the Web API SiAR remotecontrol.
  2. In the remotecontrol form, click on Procedures and select SiAR: Daily Sync.
  3. In the procedure form, click on Run Now.
